user.title: Add an Eye-Fi card
user.description: Enter the card's MAC address and upload key (found in Eye-Fi Manager's Settings.xml, or on the card packaging), the local directory to use for downloads/spooling, and where uploaded photos should end up. Geotagging is configured separately -- install and set up the WiFi Geolocation integration if you want GPS coordinates resolved from the card's WiFi scan; if it's not installed, geotagging is skipped automatically.

data.notify_service: Notify service for photo-import push notifications (optional -- e.g. "mobile_app_jims_iphone"; found under Developer Tools > Actions by searching "notify"; leave blank to disable)

destination.title: Configure the storage destination
destination.description: Fields depend on the destination you chose. For local/Apple destinations, the suggested path is a 'photos' subfolder under your download/spool directory, so the working copy and the final stored copy never collide.

error.invalid_mac: MAC address must be 12 hex characters (colons/dashes are stripped automatically)
error.invalid_upload_key: Upload key must be 32 hex characters

init.title: Add a card / change notifications
init.description: Leave the MAC address and upload key blank to change only the notify service below without adding a new card.
